semantics.card_lifecycle: combat_cards lifecycle columns, each a fact the player sees or derives from public history and each read by later play: autoplay_free = the card still holds an autoplay waiver (displayed cost 0); free_play_once = a one-use waiver from Forethought or Setup (displayed cost 0); rolled_cost = the cost rolled by Confusion or Snecko Oil (shown when drawn), unknown when none; modified_combat_cost = the card's modified combat cost (cost changes this combat, e.g. Madness, Enlightenment, Force Field), unknown when none; hp_loss_discount = Blood for Blood's discount from HP losses this combat; cost_zero_this_turn = Infernal Blade's cost 0 that ends at end of turn
semantics.creation: the resolved creation profile is configuration and player knowledge: environment_spec, reset info and the record; never a per-step column
semantics.draw_rows: M34s: every draw-pile card not published as known_draw (or as another row) is a combat_cards row in zone draw with zone_position -1/known0, after all other rows, sorted by the canonical card key (the published row without zone and zone_position, permanent_row last); tied rows are interchangeable and their order carries no information; never physical draw order
semantics.enemy_rows: present actors only (active with hp>0, or half-dead), in engine order; replaced, escaped and defeated actors are not published; logical_slot is the actor's position; a Stasis card whose holder is no longer present keeps zone stasis with stasis_enemy_row unknown until the engine returns it
semantics.heart_cap: the present Corrupt Heart's live Invincible cap; unknown without a present Heart
semantics.intent: intent_kind, intent_damage, intent_hits and intent_category are unknown while intents are hidden (Runic Dome)
semantics.intent_damage: displayed damage per hit as the original calculateDamage shows it, including the player's Intangible cap (1)
semantics.intent_hits: planned damage applications of the selected move (engine-owned; includes AI memory such as Book of Stabbing); unknown for non-attacks
semantics.offers: choice payloads: amount/card/relic/potion/neow columns as named; event_stage and event_option for event rows; param0..2 are the row's displayed numbers per param_semantics
semantics.profile: Standard: every character, A0–A20, Acts 1–4 and the Heart, all M26–M33 content
semantics.room_params: stage0..3: numbers the current room displays (Treasure stage0 = chest size 1/2/3); meanings in param_semantics
semantics.selection_operation: combat selections name their operation; Run card selections name what they are for (shop_purge, smith, neow_*, event_*), select_permanent otherwise
semantics.terminal: ongoing, death, empty_deck, act3_no_keys and heart_victory; HeartVictory follows the final Proceed; truncated is always false
semantics.vocabulary_order: open families are append-only from standard-vocab-v1; power = shared PUBLIC_POWERS order; intent = shared PUBLIC_INTENTS order then EVENT_INTENTS; a later shared power or intent appends after these rows
